title: AgenticVulHunter: Bringing Local Agentic Vulnerability Hunting to Your Terminal
abstract: arXiv:2610.27383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finding vulnerabilities early, before they can affect the production system, is important for reducing the risk of any software attacks. However, detecting vulnerabilities during secure code review is still difficult because the vulnerable code logic may depend on lines found across different repository files. Recent approaches such as AgenticSCR have shown that LLM agents can explore repository files and use security knowledge to improve secure code review. However, these approaches mainly rely on external commercial LLMs and can provide a large amount of security knowledge to the agent at once. This creates an important question of whether agentic secure code review can also be performed effectively using locally deployed open-weight LLMs with more focused and relevant security knowledge. In this paper, we propose AgenticVulHunter, an agentic secure code review approach and tool that can run with a locally deployed open-weight LLM. W

translated_title: AgenticVulHunter：将本地智能体漏洞挖掘带入你的终端
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27383v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：在漏洞影响生产系统之前尽早发现它们，对于降低软件攻击风险至关重要。然而，在安全代码审查过程中检测漏洞仍然十分困难，因为漏洞代码逻辑可能依赖于分布在代码库不同文件中的代码行。近期的方法（如AgenticSCR）已经表明，LLM智能体能够探索代码库文件并利用安全知识来改进安全代码审查。然而，这些方法主要依赖外部的商业LLM，并且可能一次性向智能体提供大量安全知识。这就引出了一个重要问题：使用本地部署的开源权重LLM并配合更加聚焦且相关的安全知识，是否同样能够有效地执行基于智能体的安全代码审查。在本文中，我们提出了AgenticVulHunter，这是一种能够在本地部署的开源权重LLM上运行的智能体安全代码审查方法与工具。
tldr: 本文提出AgenticVulHunter，一个可在本地部署的开源权重LLM上运行的智能体安全代码审查工具，通过聚焦且相关的安全知识实现终端漏洞挖掘。
en_tdlr: AgenticVulHunter is an agentic secure code review tool that runs on locally deployed open-weight LLMs with focused security knowledge, bringing vulnerability hunting directly to the terminal.
